subject: Annual prioritization lanes + budget deadlines
body:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance-partner@auditsys.io
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Annual prioritization lanes + budget deadlines

Team —

We need to kick off the annual prioritization and budgeting run. I want to establish "priority lanes" (Growth, Reliability & Ops, Platform Efficiency, Strategic Bets) and align on firm deadlines for targets and assumptions so the QBR pack is ready for the first exec review week of January. High-level asks: 

- Please review the attached priority_lanes_template.pdf and indicate which projects you want in each lane by EOD Wed (2026-11-18).
- Finance: please confirm the deadline for final assumptions you need to build headcount/cost models (I listed Wed 11/25 as a placeholder).
- Leadership: flag any projects that require separate contingency/approval processes (e.g., large infra commits, Dedicated capacity deals).

Attachments: priority_lanes_template.pdf (template)
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-prioritization

Thanks — I’ll collate responses and propose a condensed timeline for review cycles and a draft QBR agenda.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance-partner@auditsys.io
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual prioritization lanes + budget deadlines

Thanks, Soojin — good call. Quick notes: 

- I’ll push a first-pass lane mapping for GTM initiatives (PLG growth experiments, pricing pilots) by Tue 11/17 EOD.
- For QBR prep: can we reserve a 90-minute slot the week of Jan 4 for leadership dry-run? That lets us finalize narrative and slides before the exec week.
- Contingency: anything >$350k CAPEX or >3 FTEs should get a separate approval path; I’ll prefix those rows in my submission.

Also add Marissa to loop for any CS/customer-led renewal items.

Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Strategy | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: finance-partner@auditsys.io
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual prioritization lanes + budget deadlines

Adding a couple of assumptions and a working file: I attached annual_assumptions_v1.xlsx with three scenario bands (base / upside / downside) and suggested velocity multipliers per lane. Notes: 

- Timeline sanity: if we want headcount numbers into finance by 11/25, teams should lock prioritized hires by 11/20 so recruiting can start.
- Cost drivers: Dedicated capacity committed deals (sales pipeline) and global region expansion are the biggest swing items. Please flag any expected >$200k multi-region spend.
- Proposed review cadence:
  * 11/18: lane submissions due (owners to review entries)
  * 11/22–11/24: synthesis and cross-functional conflict resolution (two working slots)
  * 11/25: assumptions final to finance
  * 11/29: leadership package draft (slides + top-line targets)

Attachment: annual_assumptions_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Hi Soojin / Laura —

Thanks for looping me in. Our execs prefer a one-page summary per lane with: top initiative, ask (funding/hiring), expected impact (OKR tie), and risk. Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide that distilled page or if you want us to summarize from the lane submissions?

Best,

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@ventureco.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: finance-partner@auditsys.io
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual prioritization lanes + budget deadlines

Great questions. Quick answers/actions: 

- We will generate the one-page executive summaries from lane submissions — please use the template headers in priority_lanes_template.pdf so we can automate condensation. Jane: if you prefer to draft your own exec summaries for the deals you care about, that’s fine; we’ll reconcile during synthesis.
- Confirmed timeline: lane submissions due 11/18; synthesis working sessions 11/22–24; assumptions to finance 11/25; leadership draft 11/29; leadership dry-run week of 01/04.
- Owners: assign a primary owner for each lane row and cc any external stakeholders in the template.

Next steps (owners please):
- Laura: GTM lane first-pass by 11/17.
- Marissa: CS renewal impacts and top renewal expansion asks by 11/18.
- Aditya: Engineering capacity ask + any infra spend by 11/18.
- Vivek / Finance: confirm if 11/25 is workable for final assumptions.

I’ll collate and run the synthesis sessions; will post calendar invites for 11/22 and 11/23 slots.

Attachments referenced: priority_lanes_template.pdf, annual_assumptions_v1.xlsx
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-prioritization
HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/REDWOOD-2314
